entries.en: Luquelot appears to be in need of assistance.
entries.fr: Luquelot a l'air inquiet, et voudrait qu'on lui rende un petit service.
entries.ja: ベントブランチ牧場の飼育員ルクロは、何か「気になるもの」を見たというが……？
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: At Bentbranch Meadows, you learn from Luquelot that Ixali dirigibles have been crossing the Twelveswood's borders seemingly at will. Concerned that something may be amiss with the elementals, he has committed the details of his sightings to parchment, and bids you deliver the document to Miounne.
entries.fr: Luquelot raconte avoir aperçu des ballons ixali dans la Sylve. Il a noté les détails de cette expérience ainsi que l'endroit survolé dans une lettre, qu'il vous demande de remettre à Miounne, aux Feuilles de carline. Retournez à Gridania.
entries.ja: 黒衣森でイクサル族の気球が飛んでいるのを目撃したルクロ。彼はその目撃場所を、手紙にしたためたのだという。グリダニアへ戻り、カーラインカフェの「ミューヌ」に「ルクロの封書」を渡そう。
entries.section: Main Scenario (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)
entries.category: Seventh Umbral Era Main Scenario Quests

entries.en: Miounne's face turns deathly pale as she reads Luquelot's letter. It would seem trouble is brewing, and that your aid is needed once more. Prepare yourself for a mission of grave import, and then request further orders from Miounne.
entries.fr: Le contenu de la lettre de Luquelot semble quelque peu inquiéter Miounne. Elle va sans doute vous confier une tâche<nbsp>; interrogez-la pour en savoir plus.
entries.ja: ルクロの手紙には、なにか厄介なことが書かれていたようだ。どんな事態にも対応できるよう準備を整え、ミューヌから詳しい話を聞こう。

entries.ja:
おつかれさまです。

entries.en: Of late, I have noticed that Ixali dirigibles have been appearing over the Twelveswood with increasing regularity. The frequency, however, does not bother me near so much as <italic(1)>where<italic(0)> they choose to fly─the patch of sky directly above the Guardian Tree.
entries.macro: Of late, I have noticed that Ixali dirigibles have been appearing over the Twelveswood with increasing regularity. The frequency, however, does not bother me near so much as <italic(1)>where<italic(0)> they choose to fly─the patch of sky directly above the Guardian Tree.
entries.fr: Voilà, l'autre jour, j'ai vu des ballons ixali survoler l'Arbre gardien à plusieurs reprises.
entries.ja:
先日、この黒衣森にある「長老の木」の上空を、
イクサル族の気球が飛んでいるのを何度か見かけまして。

entries.en: The tree is a sacred site, or so I was given to believe when first I came to Gridania, and thus I naturally assumed that the elementals would not suffer the Ixal to profane it. Yet the birdmen have been coming and going as they please, with nary a sign of protest from the guardians of the Twelveswood.
entries.fr: D'ordinaire, les esprits repoussent toute incursion ixale... mais pas cette fois.
entries.ja:
普段だったら、森の精霊様は、
イクサル族など追い返してしまうのですが……。
entries.jaMacro:

entries.en: And it was that which set me to thinking... Ever since the appearance of the much-talked-about “suspicious individual,” many and more strange things have been occurring in the forest. Could it be that he did something to the elementals?
entries.fr: On dirait qu'avec toutes ces histoires d'intrus, les esprits sont distraits, ou simplement, ils ont choisi de ne pas intervenir...
entries.ja:
ここ最近は、例の「不審者」騒ぎの影響で
精霊様の力も不安定らしく、そんな気配がないのです。

entries.fr: Bref, tout cela ne me disait rien qui vaille, alors j'ai noté l'endroit précis où je les ai aperçus. Tout est dans cette lettre.
